statements.statement: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient reports intermittent palpitations with dizziness and giddiness
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered for ambulatory assessment
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes correlating with these symptoms
The service is supported by diagnoses I25.10, R00.2, and R42
